faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR NIO is 30-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc / M.Tech / M.Sc(Tech) in Geophysics / Marine Geophysics / Exploration Geophysics / Applied Geophysics to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - I post at CSIR National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate - I is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Goa.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification is for CSIR NIO, located in Goa. Candidates from all states are generally eligible to apply if they meet the criteria, but it's best to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.
